title: A Survey on Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Survey organizing efficient-VLA work across model design (architectures, compression), training, and data collection, with a living project page.
relevance_reason: Broad map of efficient VLA techniques; useful for coverage checking.

title: EdgeVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 7x speedup from removing autoregressive EE prediction
tldr: Edge VLA replaces OpenVLA's autoregressive end-effector decoding with joint prediction and swaps in a small language model, targeting edge deployment on mobile manipulators.
relevance_reason: Direct lightweight VLA for edge inference.

title: RoboMamba: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Reasoning and Manipulation
tldr: Builds a VLA on a Mamba state-space language backbone for linear-time inference, adding a small SE(3) pose head fine-tuned on ~0.1% of parameters.
relevance_reason: Seed work on SSM-based efficient VLA.

title: TinyVLA: Towards Fast, Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: A family of compact VLAs initialized from fast small multimodal models and paired with a diffusion policy decoder, skipping large-scale robot pretraining while beating OpenVLA on speed.

title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Embodied Manipulation: A Systematic Survey
tldr: Systematic survey of efficient VLAs organized by architecture, perception features, action generation, and training/inference strategies, with edge-deployment framing.

title: VLA-Cache: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation via Adaptive Token Caching
reported_metric: up to 1.7x CUDA latency speedup; +15% control frequency
tldr: Training-free method that reuses KV entries of visual tokens that barely change between consecutive frames, while recomputing task-relevant tokens with a layer-adaptive reuse ratio.
relevance_reason: Seed work on temporal token/KV caching for VLAs.

title: FLOWER: Democratizing Generalist Robot Policies with Efficient Vision-Language-Action Flow Policies
tldr: Sub-1B flow-based VLA that drops up to half of the VLM layers and shifts capacity to the flow head, reaching state of the art on CALVIN ABC with modest pretraining compute.

title: BitVLA: 1-bit Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics Manipulation
reported_metric: 11.0x lower model memory, 4.4x lower end-to-end latency vs OpenVLA-OFT
tldr: Natively ternary-weight VLA built on BitNet, with a quantize-then-distill step for the vision encoder, matching OpenVLA-OFT at a fraction of memory.
relevance_reason: Compact-by-design VLA; primarily a quantization work (C2).

title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
tldr: Hugging Face's compact VLA trained on community LeRobot data, with an async inference stack that decouples chunk prediction from execution; performs on par with VLAs 10x larger.
relevance_reason: Seed small-VLA work with async execution.

title: CogVLA: Cognition-Aligned Vision-Language-Action Model via Instruction-Driven Routing & Sparsification
reported_metric: 2.8x lower inference latency, 2.5x lower training cost vs OpenVLA
tldr: Uses instruction-conditioned FiLM routing to compress visual tokens in the encoder and prune instruction-irrelevant tokens in the LLM, plus bidirectional parallel action decoding.

title: FASTer: Toward Efficient Autoregressive Vision Language Action Modeling via Neural Action Tokenization
tldr: Learned VQ tokenizer that encodes action chunks as single-channel images for high compression, paired with a block-autoregressive VLA and a small action expert for faster decoding than FAST.
relevance_reason: Action tokenization for efficient AR VLAs.

title: ActDistill: General Action-Guided Self-Derived Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Distills a full VLA into a student with a learned router that executes only a subset of layers depending on action-prediction needs.

title: Fast-ThinkAct: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Reasoning via Verbalizable Latent Planning
reported_metric: up to 89.3% lower inference latency vs reasoning VLAs
tldr: Compresses explicit chain-of-thought in reasoning VLAs into short verbalizable latent tokens distilled from a teacher, sharply cutting reasoning latency.

title: From Inference Efficiency to Embodied Efficiency: Revisiting Efficiency Metrics for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Argues that FLOPs/params/throughput misrepresent real efficiency and shows compression or token sparsification can increase completion time or degrade motion quality even when success is unchanged.
relevance_reason: Directly relevant to how efficiency should be measured for real-time robots.

title: EfficientVLA: Training-Free Acceleration and Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 1.93x inference speedup, FLOPs reduced to 28.9%, -0.6% success
tldr: Combines pruning redundant LLM layers, task-aware visual token selection, and caching of intermediate features across diffusion-head steps to accelerate CogACT without training.

title: MoLe-VLA: Dynamic Layer-skipping Vision Language Action Model via Mixture-of-Layers for Efficient Robot Manipulation
reported_metric: up to 5.6x lower compute vs standard LLM
tldr: Treats each LLM layer as an expert and uses a spatio-temporal router to activate a subset per step, with self-distillation compensating for skipped layers.

title: FibVLA: An Efficient Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model with Fibonacci Sampling
tldr: Samples history frames and states at Fibonacci/log-spaced intervals so a VLA can use long temporal context without a proportional cost increase.

title: Beyond Attention Magnitude: Leveraging Inter-layer Rank Consistency for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Selects visual tokens using consistency of their ranking across layers rather than raw attention magnitude, cutting tokens substantially without training.

title: PolicyTrim: Boosting Intrinsic Policy Efficiency of Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: up to 5.83x end-to-end deployment speedup; 51.4% fewer execution steps
tldr: RL post-training that rewards reliably executing longer chunks and completing tasks in fewer steps, reducing the number of forward passes per task.
relevance_reason: Reframes efficiency as fewer inference calls.

title: Efficient Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models via Static-Dynamic Disentanglement
tldr: Splits visual input into static and dynamic tokens, keeping one copy of static tokens and reusing their KV cache via a recache gate, enabling cheap multi-frame context.

title: Reducing Temporal Redundancy for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
tldr: Re-encodes only dynamic image regions between frames and trains the diffusion head to sample in two steps, attacking both perception and action-generation redundancy.

title: Offline Semantic Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation
tldr: Distills billion-parameter VLAs into a 158M student using VLM-generated phase and direction cues as extra training-only supervision.

title: Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
reported_metric: 2.45x FLOPs reduction at 12.5% retention; +14.5pp over VLA-Cache
tldr: Improves VLA token caching by selecting reliable attention heads via text-vision focus and choosing which layers to reuse via entropy differences.

title: CF-VLA: Efficient Coarse-to-Fine Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Replaces Gaussian-noise starts with a learned action-aware coarse initialization followed by one refinement step, giving strong results at two function evaluations.

title: Action-aware Dynamic Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
tldr: Adjusts visual-token retention by manipulation phase, pruning more during coarse motion and less during fine operations, gated by recent action trajectories.

title: Bidirectional Decoding: Improving Action Chunking via Guided Test-Time Sampling
tldr: Analyzes the consistency-vs-reactivity tradeoff of action chunking and proposes sampling multiple chunks and choosing one coherent with past actions and likely future plans.

title: Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies
tldr: Physical Intelligence's RTC: generates the next chunk while executing the current one, freezing committed actions and inpainting the rest so diffusion/flow VLAs stay smooth under latency.
relevance_reason: Core technique for real-time VLA execution.

title: PD-VLA: Accelerating Vision-Language-Action Model Integrated with Action Chunking via Parallel Decoding
tldr: Turns autoregressive decoding of chunked action tokens into parallel fixed-point (Jacobi) iterations, speeding up decoding without retraining.

title: Adaptive Action Chunking at Inference-time for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Chooses chunk length at inference based on predicted-action entropy, balancing reactivity and consistency.

title: Real-Time Robot Execution with Masked Action Chunking
tldr: Fine-tunes chunking policies with masked action chunks so they tolerate mismatch between planned and actually executed actions during async inference, plus prefix-preserved sampling.

title: GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies
tldr: Uses geometric variation of flow-matching denoising trajectories as an uncertainty proxy to pick the execution horizon from one generation.

title: Knowing When to Stop: Adaptive Action Chunking via Internal Cross-Attention Dynamics in VLAs
tldr: Truncates executed chunks when action-to-observation cross-attention entropy plateaus, using attention already computed by the action expert.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
reported_metric: ~10% better smoothness and completion time vs RTC
tldr: Legato trains flow VLAs to start denoising from a mix of known actions and noise, building chunk continuation into the policy rather than applying RTC externally.

title: Mixture of Horizons in Action Chunking
tldr: Processes several chunk horizons in parallel with a shared action transformer and gated fusion, enabling adaptive horizons via cross-horizon consensus.

title: Leave No Observation Behind: Real-time Correction for VLA Action Chunks
tldr: A small correction head runs every control step and adjusts a big VLA's chunked actions using the latest observation, restoring reactivity under delay.

title: FutureRTC: Real-Time Robot Execution with Anticipatory-Conditioned Action Chunking
tldr: Predicts execution-time proprioception and visual features so asynchronous VLA chunks are conditioned on where the robot will be, not where it was.

title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
tldr: Picks replanning points at low-speed transitions in the predicted chunk's velocity profile.

title: Bridging the Semantic-Action Gap in Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA Inference
tldr: VLA-Pruner scores tokens using both prefill semantic salience and temporally smoothed action-decode relevance, fixing VLM-style pruning that drops action-critical tokens.

title: SP-VLA: A Joint Model Scheduling and Token Pruning Approach for VLA Model Acceleration
tldr: Routes 'intuitive' steps to a lightweight generator and 'deliberative' steps to the full VLA, combined with spatio-semantic token pruning.

title: The Better You Learn, The Smarter You Prune: Towards Efficient Vision-language-action Models via Differentiable Token Pruning
tldr: LightVLA learns which visual tokens to keep with Gumbel-softmax selection during fine-tuning, improving both efficiency and success.

title: BFA++: Hierarchical Best-Feature-Aware Token Prune for Multi-View Vision Language Action Model
tldr: Hierarchical pruning for multi-camera VLAs: intra-view predictors keep task regions, inter-view predictors drop cameras irrelevant to the current phase.

title: DTP: A Simple yet Effective Distracting Token Pruning Framework for Vision-Language Action Models
tldr: Detects and prunes image tokens in task-irrelevant regions that attract attention, aiming mainly at success-rate gains rather than speed.
relevance_reason: Pruning mostly for accuracy, weak efficiency angle.

title: SQAP-VLA: A Synergistic Quantization-Aware Pruning Framework for High-Performance Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Co-designs aggressive quantization with token-pruning criteria that remain reliable on quantized models, so both can be used together without training.

title: SAFE-Pruner: Semantic Attention-Guided Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
tldr: Forecasts deep-layer token saliency using attention that persists on the same semantic entities over time, avoiding premature removal by shallow-layer pruning.

title: Shallow-π: Knowledge Distillation for Flow-based VLAs
tldr: Distills a flow-based VLA's VLM and action head from 18 to 6 layers, validated on Jetson Orin/Thor across robots including humanoids.

title: AC^2-VLA: Action-Context-Aware Adaptive Computation in Vision-Language-Action Models for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Conditions how much of the VLA to run on observations, instruction and previous actions, unifying reuse across timesteps, token pruning, and selective component execution.

title: Compressor-VLA: Instruction-Guided Visual Token Compression for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Instruction-conditioned compressors distill task context and fine spatial detail into a few visual tokens.

title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation
reported_metric: end-to-end latency 274 ms -> 83 ms (pi0.5); 9.6x denoising speedup
tldr: Self-distills flow-matching VLAs to one function evaluation by mixing flow targets with two-step Euler shortcut targets, with no teacher or architecture change.

title: Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Compresses the value vectors of retained tokens with a role- and language-conditioned router, complementing token pruning for aggressive KV reduction.

title: Environment-Aware Adaptive Pruning with Interleaved Inference Orchestration for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Training-free channel pruning whose sparsity pattern updates with the environment, scheduled in idle FLOP bubbles of VLA inference.

title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Token Compression in Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Scores tokens by how much they can change before the VLA's action response deviates, and uses this as a criterion for pruning or stale-KV reuse.

title: Training-Free Interaction-Aligned Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Embodied Manipulation
tldr: Sets a per-frame token budget from agreement between instruction semantics and image motion, then selects tokens with geometric boundary correction.

title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for VLA Inference under Multi-Task Parallelism
reported_metric: up to 3.7x speedup; >200 tok/s language + 70 Hz action simultaneously
tldr: Treats the KV cache as a shared resource across concurrent VLA tasks (acting, talking, memory) and across frames, avoiding redundant prefill and decoupling language decoding from fixed-rate action generation.
relevance_reason: On-device serving system for MoT VLAs.

title: KV-Efficient VLA: A Method to Speed up Vision Language Models with RNN-Gated Chunked KV Cache
reported_metric: 1.34x speedup, 1.87x less KV memory, 24.6% FLOPs saved
tldr: Chunks the historical KV cache and uses a recurrent gate to summarize and drop low-utility history for long-horizon VLAs.

title: Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs
tldr: Adds distilled exit heads to both the VLM backbone and action expert and treats backbone depth, expert depth, and denoising steps as jointly tunable compute axes.

title: BlockVLA: Accelerating Autoregressive VLA via Block Diffusion Finetuning
tldr: Fine-tunes AR VLA backbones into block diffusion policies: autoregressive across blocks with prefix KV reuse, parallel denoising within blocks.

title: Reflex: Real-Time VLA Control through Streaming Inference
reported_metric: 2.58x speedup; 50 Hz stable streaming; up to 54% lower reaction latency
tldr: Enables O(1) incremental KV updates for flow VLAs by separating static/sliding/dynamic context, plus a normalization fix for bf16 stability and an async encode/act pipeline.

title: AsyncVLA: Asynchronous Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Generates action tokens on non-uniform timestep schedules and refines only low-confidence tokens, improving long-horizon stability.

title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Extends VLA-Cache by invalidating the cache whenever the top-2 action-token logit margin drops, recovering accuracy lost by blind caching while keeping most savings.

title: Latent Bridge: Feature Delta Prediction for Efficient Dual-System Vision-Language-Action Model Inference
tldr: Learns to predict how VLM outputs change between steps so the action head can run on predicted features while the backbone runs only periodically.

title: dVLA: Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
tldr: Unified diffusion VLA that jointly generates reasoning and actions, using prefix attention masking and KV caching to cut inference latency.

title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Conditions a VLA on target execution speed, trained via demonstration re-timing, allowing faster motion in transit and slower in contact phases.

title: BLURR: A Boosted Low-Resource Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Training-free inference wrapper for pi0 combining instruction-prefix KV caching, mixed precision, and a single-step rollout for commodity GPUs.
relevance_reason: Practical inference stack for flow VLA.

title: CrossVLA: Cross-Paradigm Post-Training and Inference Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: denoising loop is 78.6% of sample_actions latency; prefix KV caching capped at 21% speedup
tldr: Empirical study that, among other things, profiles flow-VLA inference and finds the denoise loop dominates latency while prefix caching gives limited gains and can hurt success.

title: Learning to Accelerate Vision-Language-Action Models through Adaptive Visual Token Caching
tldr: Replaces heuristic caching with trainable modules deciding which and how many visual tokens to reuse, optimized end-to-end with a differentiable relaxation.

title: Fewer Steps, Better Actions: Rethinking Flow-Matching Inference for VLA Policies
reported_metric: 2-step config 2.12x speedup; 5-step 30.2% lower forward latency vs 10-step
tldr: Spends part of the integration budget on a learned one-shot residual correction of a few-step flow sample, improving the quality-latency frontier of frozen flow VLAs.

title: SwiftVLA: Unlocking Spatiotemporal Dynamics for Lightweight VLA Models at Minimal Overhead
reported_metric: 18x faster, 12x less memory vs larger VLAs on edge devices
tldr: Gives a compact VLA 4D spatiotemporal understanding via a geometry transformer branch that is trained with masking so it can be dropped at inference.

title: rMuscle: Robotic Muscle Memory for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference
tldr: Exploits similarity across repeated factory executions by caching visual-token outputs and neuron activation masks for reuse.

title: ActionCache: Training-Free Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Models with Action Caching and Refinement
reported_metric: action-head speedup up to 10.44x (pi0.5) and 40.17x (GR00T N1.6)
tldr: Stores intermediate actions under compact multimodal keys and warm-starts flow denoising from retrieved similar contexts.

title: TTF-VLA: Temporal Token Fusion via Pixel-Attention Integration for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Fuses historical and current visual tokens where frames are unchanged, mainly boosting robustness; notes that query reuse could enable acceleration.

title: FASA: Feedback-Aware Sampling Adaptation for Efficient Diffusion-Based VLA Models
tldr: Adapts the number of diffusion sampling steps at runtime using visual and gripper-force feedback and proprioception.

title: TIDAL: Temporally Interleaved Diffusion and Action Loop for High-Frequency VLA Control
tldr: Runs a slow semantic loop with cached embeddings and a fast loop interleaving single-step flow integration with execution, trained to compensate stale intent.

title: vla.simd: Efficient CPU Inference for Language-Conditioned Manipulation
reported_metric: 33.5 actions/s fp32, 81.2 actions/s int8 on Raspberry Pi 5; ~1.4x over compiled PyTorch
tldr: CPU inference engine for language-conditioned policies plus a small ACT-based policy that sustains >30 actions/s on a Raspberry Pi 5.

title: NanoVLA: Routing Decoupled Vision-Language Understanding for Nano-sized Generalist Robotic Policies
reported_metric: up to 52x faster inference on edge, 98% fewer parameters
tldr: Nano-scale VLAs that fuse vision and language late (allowing caching) and route between light and heavy backbones by task difficulty.

title: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Models across XPUs: Constraints and Acceleration for On-Robot Deployment
tldr: Benchmarks VLAs across heterogeneous accelerators on cost/energy/time, finding a compute-bound backbone then memory-bound action expert, and proposes caching plus pipeline overlap.

title: Fast ECoT: Efficient Embodied Chain-of-Thought via Thoughts Reuse
tldr: Caches high-level ECoT reasoning across timesteps, parallelizes reasoning modules, and decouples reasoning from action decoding.

title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
tldr: AI2's open action-reasoning VLA with an open FAST-style tokenizer, a flow-matching expert grafted via per-layer KV conditioning, and a reasoning variant that recomputes depth tokens only for changed regions.

title: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
tldr: Tests why chunking helps BC, finding non-Markovian expressivity and implicit ensembling rather than temporal consistency, and matches chunking with randomized-delay ensembles.

title: CEED-VLA: Consistency Vision-Language-Action Model with Early-Exit Decoding
tldr: Trains AR VLAs with consistency distillation so Jacobi iterations converge on several action tokens per step, and relaxes convergence to exit decoding early.

title: DeeAD: Dynamic Early Exit of Vision-Language Action for Efficient Autonomous Driving
reported_metric: up to 29% latency reduction, 28% layer sparsity
tldr: Terminates driving-VLA inference once intermediate trajectories agree with cheap planning priors within tolerance, plus multi-hop layer skipping.
relevance_reason: Early exit for VLA, driving domain.

title: Think Less, Act Early: Reinforced Latent Reasoning with Early Exit in Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Replaces text CoT with RL-denoised latent reasoning variables and stops reasoning early when state confidence is high.

title: DeeR-VLA: Dynamic Inference of Multimodal Large Language Models for Efficient Robot Execution
reported_metric: 5.2-6.5x lower LLM compute; 2-6x lower LLM GPU memory
tldr: Multi-exit robotic MLLM that picks how many layers to run per situation, with exit criteria set by average/peak compute and memory budgets.

title: LoopVLA: Learning Sufficiency in Recurrent Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Applies a shared transformer block recurrently and learns when the representation is sufficient to stop, trading depth for adaptive iterations.

title: Emergent Compositional Skills in Mixture-of-Experts VLAs
tldr: Shows an MoE action head in a VLA learns reusable, interpretable experts matching distinct low-level behaviors with no performance loss.

title: HiMoE-VLA: Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for Generalist Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Hierarchical MoE action module specializing boundary layers by action space and middle layers by observation/embodiment heterogeneity.

title: Expertise need not monopolize: Action-Specialized Mixture of Experts for Vision-Language-Action Learning
tldr: AdaMoE upcycles a dense VLA's action-expert FFNs into sparse MoE layers with a scale adapter decoupled from the router, adding capacity at similar compute.

title: Dense to MoE Adaptation for Compact Vision Language Action Policies
tldr: Converts dense FFNs into MoE and deactivates rarely-routed experts during fine-tuning to shrink the deployed VLA.

title: GeRM: A Generalist Robotic Model with Mixture-of-experts for Quadruped Robot
tldr: Quadruped VLA using an MoE transformer to raise capacity while keeping inference cheap, trained with offline RL on demonstrations and suboptimal data.

title: PAMAE: Phase-Aware-MoE Action Experts Towards Reliable Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Replaces a flow VLA's single action expert with a sparse phase-routed expert mixture for more reliable multi-stage manipulation.
relevance_reason: MoE for reliability rather than efficiency.

title: Spec-VLA: Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models with Relaxed Acceptance
tldr: First speculative decoding framework for VLAs, relaxing acceptance by tolerating nearby action-token bins.

title: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 1.5x matched-success speedup over VLA speculative decoding
tldr: Injects world-model-derived scene awareness into VLA prefill so relaxed speculative acceptance stays safe near contact.

title: KERV: Kinematic-Rectified Speculative Decoding for Embodied VLA Models
tldr: Uses a kinematic Kalman-filter prediction to correct draft errors and adapt acceptance thresholds in VLA speculative decoding.

title: HeiSD: Hybrid Speculative Decoding for Embodied Vision-Language-Action Models with Kinematic Awareness
tldr: Combines drafter-based and retrieval-based speculative decoding for VLAs, choosing between them with a kinematics-based metric and relaxing sequence acceptance.

title: Action Deviation-Aware Inference for Low-Latency Wireless Robots
reported_metric: 39.2% lower end-to-end latency; ~40% fewer server calls
tldr: On-device draft policy sends actions for server verification only when predicted deviation is large, cutting communication and latency for networked robots.

title: Consistency Policy: Accelerated Visuomotor Policies via Consistency Distillation
reported_metric: order-of-magnitude faster inference than fastest alternative
tldr: Distills Diffusion Policy into a consistency model enabling one/few-step action generation on resource-limited platforms.
relevance_reason: Seed work on fast diffusion policies.

title: Hybrid Consistency Policy: Decoupling Multi-Modal Diversity and Real-Time Efficiency in Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Runs a short stochastic denoising prefix then a single consistency jump, preserving multimodality while cutting latency relative to an 80-step DDPM teacher.

title: ManiCM: Real-time 3D Diffusion Policy via Consistency Model for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Applies consistency distillation to 3D point-cloud diffusion policies for one-step action generation.

title: One-Step Diffusion Policy: Fast Visuomotor Policies via Diffusion Distillation
tldr: NVIDIA's OneDP distills a diffusion policy into a single-step generator by minimizing KL along the diffusion chain at 2-10% extra pretraining cost.

title: Mean-Flow based One-Step Vision-Language-Action
reported_metric: 8.7x faster than SmolVLA, 83.9x faster than Diffusion Policy (generation speed)
tldr: Swaps the flow-matching action head for a MeanFlow average-velocity formulation enabling one-step generation in a VLA.

title: HybridFlow: A 2-NFE Generative Policy for Real-Time Robotic Manipulation
reported_metric: ~8x lower action-generation latency than 16-step Diffusion Policy
tldr: Two-evaluation policy: a MeanFlow global jump, parameter-free re-noising, and one local refinement step with the same network, no distillation.

title: ElasticFlow: One-Step Physics-Consistent Policy with Elastic Time Horizons for Language-Guided Manipulation
tldr: Distillation-free one-step policy based on average-velocity modeling with horizon encoding for varying control granularity.

title: FlowPolicy: Enabling Fast and Robust 3D Flow-based Policy via Consistency Flow Matching for Robot Manipulation
tldr: Consistency flow matching on point-cloud policies to produce actions in one step.

tldr: Flow policy with consistency training generating dexterous actions in 1-2 steps, using a DiT with adaptive cross-attention conditioning.

title: Fast and Robust Visuomotor Riemannian Flow Matching Policy
tldr: Flow-matching policy on Riemannian manifolds with a stable variant, faster to train and sample than diffusion or consistency policies.

title: Dense-Jump Flow Matching with Non-Uniform Time Scheduling for Robotic Policies: Mitigating Multi-Step Inference Degradation
tldr: Finds more Euler steps hurt flow policies and proposes U-shaped training time sampling plus a single jump past a cutoff at inference.

tldr: Represents action chunks as Legendre polynomials and starts flow from previous coefficients, enabling accurate single-step long-horizon generation.

title: Fast Flow-based Visuomotor Policies via Conditional Optimal Transport Couplings
tldr: Conditional optimal-transport couplings between noise and actions straighten flow ODEs so policies work in 1-2 steps without distillation.

title: EfficientFlow: Efficient Equivariant Flow Policy Learning for Embodied AI

title: WarmPrior: Straightening Flow-Matching Policies with Temporal Priors
tldr: Replaces the Gaussian source with a prior built from recent action history, producing straighter flow paths and higher success.

tldr: Invertible-network adapter constrains flow generation to a latent space where a single denoising step suffices, applied to VLAs.

title: FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: up to 5x less training time vs diffusion VLA
tldr: Physical Intelligence's DCT+BPE action tokenizer that compresses high-frequency action chunks so autoregressive VLAs (pi0-FAST) can learn dexterous tasks; releases universal FAST+.

title: OAT: Ordered Action Tokenization
tldr: Learned tokenizer producing causally ordered action tokens, so prefixes decode to coarse actions and inference cost can be traded for fidelity.

title: BEAST: Efficient Tokenization of B-Splines Encoded Action Sequences for Imitation Learning
tldr: Encodes action chunks as B-spline control points giving fixed-length tokens that decode in parallel and stay smooth across chunks, with no tokenizer training.

title: OmniSAT: Compact Action Token, Faster Auto Regression
tldr: B-spline normalization plus multi-stage residual quantization per action subspace to shorten AR action sequences.

title: VQ-VLA: Improving Vision-Language-Action Models via Scaling Vector-Quantized Action Tokenizers
tldr: Scales a VQ action tokenizer on a large mostly synthetic trajectory corpus, speeding inference and smoothing actions of VLAs.
